entry.title: New: Bill 15 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS ORDINANCE NO. 16-85 WHICH AMENDED ORDINANCE NO. 06-114, WHICH AMENDED SECTION 25-8-33 (CITY OF HILO ZONE MAP), ARTICLE 8, CHAPTER 25 (ZONING CODE) OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED) BY CHANGING THE DISTRICT CLASSIFICATION FROM SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENTIAL – 10,000 SQUARE FEET (RS-10) TO GENERAL COMMERCIAL – 20,000 SQUARE FEET (CG-20) AT WAIĀKEA HOUSE LOTS, HAWAI‘I, COVE

Big Island Candies, Inc.) (Area: Approx. 45,450 square feet) The Windward Planning Commission forwards its favorable recommendation for the applicant’s request for an eight-year time extension to Condition C (Time Requirement to Complete Construction) and Conditions D, E, and F (Roadway Improvements) for the development of a production facility, cold storage, and visitor center. The property is located along the makai side of Kekūanāoʻa
